summary.en: Chinese Maritime Militia vessels continue to conduct dangerous maneuvers against Philippine patrol assets, including the BRP Cabra and its RHIB, while repelling two militia vessels that anchored illegally in the West Philippine Sea. The Philippines has expanded maritime cooperation, conducting joint naval exercises with France in the Sulu Sea and adding five new Coast Guard vessels through a partnership with Japan. Finland has signed a maritime security pact that involves Australian support for drones and cybersecurity. 176 battle-related deaths were reported in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Kinesiske maritime militsfartøyer fortsetter å utføre farlige manøvrer mot filippinske patruljeenheter, inkludert BRP Cabra og dens RHIB, mens de avviser to militsfartøyer som ankret ulovlig i Vestfilippinene. Filippinene har utvidet maritimt samarbeid, gjennomfører felles marineøvelser med Frankrike i Suluhavet og legger til fem nye kystvaktskip gjennom et partnerskap med Japan. Finland har signert en maritim sikkerhetspakt som innebærer australsk støtte til droner og cybersikkerhet. 176 kamprelaterte dødsfall ble rapportert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
